experiment: Held-out check of a more realistic Prefill-blocking calculation and a small TTFT profile-uncertainty reserve
basis: Mechanism screening uses h103 and h105 only. h104 and h106 are deliberately reserved for later confirmation and are not evaluated during screening.
important_limitation: These workloads existed historically in the repository, so they are held out from the current mechanism-design step, not globally unseen data.

model_guardrails.request_arrival: same AICCC/HELIX Azure-derived workload construction and time-scaling
model_guardrails.latency_semantics: standard first-output TTFT and request-average post-first TPOT
model_guardrails.network_accounting: unchanged AICCC residual-time -> omega -> delta -> required-bandwidth chain

reference.source: existing pinned HELIX raw-reference records already produced for formal workloads

blocking.label: current full Prefill blocking
blocking.explanation: charge the full profiled Prefill service of every active Prefill request, plus full intrinsic overhead

blocking.label: remaining Prefill blocking
blocking.explanation: charge only the average remaining fraction of known profiled Prefill service during each overlap interval; keep intrinsic overhead fully charged because its time placement is unknown

candidate_mechanisms.explanation: TTFT reserve is accounting-only and equals the chosen fraction of profile-driven arrival-to-first-token time

outputs: false acceptance and false rejection counts
trajectory hash parity across accounting-only candidates
selection_rule: Do not choose a final mechanism only because it has the best aggregate score. Prefer a candidate only if it reduces conservative mistakes without increasing unsafe approvals on the held-out set, and keep all limitations explicit.
protocol_amendment: Before the first held-out run produced any result, the full h103-h106 screen was recognized as unnecessarily expensive. The mechanism-screening population is restricted to the two short held-out workloads h103 and h105. The two longer workloads h104 and h106 are reserved untouched for a later confirmation after a candidate is frozen.
